The worker bees are all female, and they do all the chores. They fly from flower to flower to collect a sweet liquid called nectar. Back at the hive, the workers turn the nectar into honey, which they store in tiny wax cells called a honeycomb. Bees communicate with each other by performing a special dance. This dance tells other bees exactly where to find the best flowers.
